function submitFormQueryebookMain(){
	var queryinfo = $('#input_id').val();
	queryinfo = queryinfo.replace(/\+/g, "%2B");

	console.log(queryinfo);
	var baseurl=$('#id_history_download').attr("baseurl");
	url = baseurl + "src/search.php?queryinfo=" + encodeURIComponent(queryinfo);
	window.open(url, '_blank').location;
}

function js_method(){
	if($('#main-frame-error').is(':visible'))

};
